newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Superconductor to redeem warrants.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Superconductor to redeem warrants.

text.p: Illinois Superconductor Corp said Thursday it would redeem on December 23 all 345,773 of its outstanding redeemable common stock purchase warrants expiring November 14, 1997.
The warrants were issued in November 1995 in a private placement and may be exercised at $13 per share prior to the redemption date.
The company said it has reserved the right to extend the redemption date.
Shares of Illinois Superconductor closed Wednesday at 17-1/2.
The company provides high-temperature superconducting technology for the wireless telecommunications industry.
